title: Tenure Credit on the Cure for Long-Standing RentGuard Policyholders
content:
A RentGuard Renters Policy reinstated after a nonpayment cancellation has a tenure credit taken off the cure according to how long the policy has been held.

## The credit

- When the whole months from the renters original effective date to today are 36 or more, 3.00 is taken off the cure.
- When they are 24 or more but fewer than 36, 1.50 is taken off the cure.
- When they are fewer than 24, no tenure credit applies.

## Questions answered

**From which date is tenure counted?** From the original effective date shown on the RentGuard policy, which is the first inception date of the policy, not the start of the current term.

**How are the months counted?** In whole months from the original effective date to today; a part month does not count.

**What does a policy with exactly 24 whole months receive?** 1.50, because 24 whole months is within the band of 24 or more but fewer than 36. At 23 whole months no credit applies.

**What does a policy with exactly 36 whole months receive?** 3.00. At 35 whole months the credit is 1.50.

| Whole months since the original effective date | Taken off the cure |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 3.00 |
| 24 to 35 | 1.50 |
| fewer than 24 | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A hypothetical policy first effective 50 whole months ago has 3.00 taken off the cure; one first effective 30 whole months ago has 1.50 taken off; one first effective 10 whole months ago has no tenure credit.
